estimated_steps: Wash the rice well and soak it for 20 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cardamoms, and cloves.
Add the drained rice and gently sauté for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and water.
Add the salt and sugar, then mix gently.
Bring it to a gentle boil, cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook on the lowest heat for 12-15 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, switch off the flame. At this stage, the rice may look slightly soft because the trapped steam is still carrying moisture.
Let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes. During this time, the steam redistributes evenly through the rice and the starch begins to set, making the grains light, fluffy and well-separated.
